name: Groundwork Design System
notice: Independent Speculative Concept — Not Affiliated with Artemis.

surfaces.mist: Opt-in cool surface. Put data-surface="mist" on a wrapper (marketing page only): remaps paper.base/sunken/inverse and line.* to the color.mist.* tokens. Generated into tokens.css from color.mist.*

forbidden: Tailwind default palette (e.g. bg-blue-500) — disabled, generates nothing

components.name: Button

props.variant: primary | accent | secondary | ghost | danger (default secondary)
props.press: boolean — marketing press feel: scale to 97% (buttonStyles and Button)

rules: One primary per view region
danger only for destructive actions
Explain disabled state with visible text + aria-describedby

components.name: IconButton
rules: Pair with Tooltip showing the same label

components.name: Field
rules: Wrap exactly one control
Errors explain how to fix

components.name: Switch
rules: Only for settings that apply immediately

components.name: Tooltip
rules: Supplementary only; never essential info
Esc dismisses (WCAG 1.4.13)

props.tone: neutral | success | warning | danger | info | accent
props.shape: tag | pill (pill = soft, rounded, borderless; marketing only)

components.name: Table
rules: Render a card list below 768px

components.name: Toast
components.api: const toast = useToast(); toast({ title, description?, tone?: 'success'|'info'|'danger', action?: { label, onClick }, duration? })

components.name: EmptyState
rules: Say why it is empty and offer the next step

components.name: Skeleton
rules: Mirror final layout
Set aria-busy on the region

components.name: EditorialSection

props.index: string, optional number after the tag label
props.label: string (circle-dot tag, shown uppercase)
props.title: ReactNode (the h2, 64px medium, -0.03em)
props.align: left | center | split (tag left, heading right)

rules: One h2 per section
Marketing pages only; the app uses Card/CardHeader
On ink bands use only ink.inverse*, line.inverse* and ember.400 for text

components.name: SpecimenFrame

props.label: string (mono label above)
props.caption: ReactNode
props.bleed: none | right | left (crop off the layout edge)

rules: Children are live design-system components, never screenshots
Say what the viewer is looking at in the caption
Do not put focusable controls in a frame unless the frame is an intentional demo

components.name: Panel

props.tone: light | dark | wash (dark has a faint grid, wash shows Atmosphere)
props.elevated: boolean, no outline + large soft shadow (light tone, floats over a gradient)

rules: Marketing surface; the app uses Card
Use as=section with an aria-label or heading when it is a landmark
Decoration is aria-hidden; content sits above it

components.name: CountUp

props.value: number (final value; screen readers always get this)

rules: Counts once, on first scroll into view
Shows the final value at once with reduced motion
Use for headline numbers, not data people compare

components.name: ChatBubble
rules: Use for messages people read, instead of a labelled box
Put in a block container; the homeowner bubble aligns itself right

components.name: CardStack

props.children: each child becomes one floating card (3-4 read best)
props.delay: seconds before the first card arrives (others follow 0.12s apart)
props.float: boolean, slow idle float (stops with reduced motion)

rules: Put live components inside, never screenshots
No device frames: the stack is as tall as its content

components.name: Atmosphere

props.parallax: boolean (default true; ignored with reduced motion)
props.from: top | bottom (bottom: base above, coral rising from the bottom)

rules: Decorative only: aria-hidden, no interactive children
Keep text on the pale sky/peach areas; coral only behind white cards
Place inside a relative isolate wrapper; fades into paper.base, so wrap the page in data-surface="mist" for the cool base

components.name: Reveal
components.motion: opacity + transform only; soft spring (stiffness 400, damping 70, no bounce); scale uses a livelier spring; shows content immediately under prefers-reduced-motion
rules: Never for repeated or frequent actions
Do not wrap content that must be read immediately above the fold in long delays

components.name: ThreadRail
rules: Shown from 1024px up; small screens need another way to navigate
Each stop is a real link with a text label

productPatterns.name: HealthBadge
productPatterns.notes: Icon + label for Health; never color alone

productPatterns.name: UpdateComposer
productPatterns.notes: Drafted homeowner message + plain-language check + live preview
